notes.text: Routing Lab - OSPF over L3 EtherChannel: Po1 (F0/1-2, 200M) 10.0.12.0/30 + backup F0/3 (100M) 10.0.21.0/30. ref-bw 1000 -> Po1 cost 5, F0/3 cost 10 -> Po1 only. Shut 1 Po1 member -> Po1 cost 10 -> ECMP over both links [110/20]. PC1 10.1.1.10 gw .1, PC2 10.2.2.10 gw .1. Sim tip: clear ip ospf process to re-run SPF.
